items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: they had a boy they called Williams, I can't think of his other name.

ctx.x: Well, I remember at, at Villery and then they had a boy they called Williams, I can't think of his other name. He died in California. He and Basher tied up and it was, it was about even, even.
You'd say Basher was right at the top though, would you?
